scope: Original 2020 Dune: Imperium standard 2–4-player base game, including mandatory two-player House Hagal. Solo, variants, expansions, promos and Uprising excluded.
verdict: One proposed distinct card-defined choice restriction; no material answer-key correction found. Saturation depends on adjudicating the explicit OR branch described below.

sources_read.method: Complete extracted text cross-checked against complete authoritative PDF in-scope text and visuals.
Read text and rendered every in-scope page. Enlarged p12 Master Tactician illustration separately. Page20 solo rules excluded.
Read all four PDF pages through both columns; separated base entries from expansion/Uprising/solo entries.
Inspected original publisher image; compared against p19 inset and Q74. Used only card instructions relevant to two-player automation.
Compared all75 question prompts literally with source procedures.
Compared all75 fixed answers with sources and scope.
Read ledger and checked claimed saturation and rejection boundary; did not open any referenced reviewer report.

key_review.result: All75 answers are supportable within scope. No expansion-only answer requirement found. In particular Q39/Q21 correctly use FAQ timing instead of old p16 immediate Mentat wording, Q74 matches the exact 2020 publisher card, and Q75 matches the printed different-Faction menu.

findings.finding: The illustrated card has three sword icons, OR, Retreat up to three of your troops. No current question requires selecting only one of those alternatives. Q09/Q10 cover strength and Combat timing, Q45 covers retreat destinations/zero, and Q37 states ordinary effects are mandatory unless its listed exceptions apply. They do not ask how this explicit OR changes which effects resolve.
findings.recommended_action: Adjudicate as one addition (or add an explicit OR-choice clause to an existing question). Do not add independent arithmetic or retreat-limit questions.

proposed_questions.question: When you play Master Tactician during Combat, can you gain its three-sword bonus and also retreat troops from that same play, or must you choose between the printed effects? If you choose retreat, where do those troops go?
proposed_questions.fixed_answer: Choose one of the two effects: gain the three-sword bonus, or retreat up to three of your troops from the Conflict to your garrison. You cannot resolve both alternatives from the same play. Choosing retreat does not also award the printed three swords.

source_references.section: Master Tactician illustrated Combat Intrigue: three sword icons, OR, Retreat up to three of your troops.
Retreat moves a troop from the Conflict to its garrison.

proposed_questions.novelty: The claimed novelty is only the explicit mutually exclusive outcome branch, not the sword amount, retreat cap, troop destination or arithmetic. No existing prompt asks for exclusivity of card effects. This is analogous to the accepted Q75 allocation restriction: source-printed choice semantics change the permitted outcome. It is not a substitution of different numbers into an existing strength or retreat question.
proposed_questions.counterargument: Under a narrower interpretation that treats any OR between already-tested atomic effects as a mechanical recombination, reject this candidate and record zero additions. I judge the explicit prohibition on resolving both to be a distinct card-defined branch under the supplied rule.
